stage_statuses.reason: full-flow stage manifest artifact is present
stage_statuses.physical_meaning: The stage manifest maps the complete V1.5 flow into machine-readable automation states, evidence contracts, and live/write authorization gates.

stage_statuses.title: Full-flow live-runner readiness
stage_statuses.reason: full-flow live-runner readiness artifact is present
stage_statuses.physical_meaning: The readiness artifact states which V1.5 domains are offline-supervised and which still require controlled real-COM, pressure, route, or SENCO-write gates before a future one-button live runner may be trusted.

stage_statuses.title: Full-flow contract audit gate
stage_statuses.physical_meaning: Before any formal run advance, the plan must prove pressure-first, open-flow component sampling, no V2 real COM, and no auto-write boundaries.

stage_statuses.title: Plan and traceability snapshots
stage_statuses.reason: formal plan or pressure reference snapshot missing
stage_statuses.physical_meaning: The calibration result must bind to a plan, standard/reference certificates, and config identity before sampling.

stage_statuses.title: Analyzer identity and GETCO epoch 0
stage_statuses.reason: GETCO snapshot or runtime identity-bound config missing
stage_statuses.physical_meaning: COM ports are transport only; analyzer device IDs and GETCO1-9 define the pre-calibration coefficient epoch.

stage_statuses.title: Pressure channel quick check or completion
stage_statuses.reason: pressure quick-check or pressure-channel completion evidence missing
stage_statuses.physical_meaning: Analyzer pressure P is an input to CO2/H2O compensation and must be verified before component calibration.

stage_statuses.title: CO2 open-flow evidence
stage_statuses.physical_meaning: CO2 fitting must be based on clean open-flow samples and factory ratio evidence, not sealed contaminated pressure points.

stage_statuses.title: CO2 queue failure audit
stage_statuses.reason: CO2 queue failure audit not generated
stage_statuses.physical_meaning: A finished CO2 queue must preserve why any point failed: insufficiently dry dewpoint, dewpoint rebound, analyzer startup, route readiness, or other diagnostic causes. Failed or downgraded points remain evidence, but must not silently enter formal coefficient fitting.

stage_statuses.title: H2O open-flow evidence
stage_statuses.physical_meaning: H2O fitting must preserve dewpoint/reference-backed water evidence and dry-gas low-water anchors separately from CO2 zero gas.

stage_statuses.title: H2O queue failure audit
stage_statuses.reason: no H2O queue failure audit artifact found
stage_statuses.physical_meaning: A finished H2O queue must preserve why any point failed: humidity generator state, dewpoint/reference instability, H2O ratio or signal instability, route readiness, or diagnostic pressure causes. Failed or downgraded H2O points remain evidence, but must not silently enter formal H2O fitting.

stage_statuses.title: H2O queue abort/exclusion evidence
stage_statuses.reason: no H2O queue abort/exclusion artifact found
stage_statuses.physical_meaning: Aborted H2O queue rows are retained as diagnostic evidence and must not enter formal fit, acceptance, or SENCO review.

stage_statuses.title: Candidate coefficient review
stage_statuses.physical_meaning: Only stable, role-eligible samples should enter SENCO candidate fitting and reviewer approval.

stage_statuses.title: Post-run coefficient closure executor
stage_statuses.physical_meaning: After CO2/H2O acquisition and fit-input review, this offline executor binds per-device eligibility, controlled write package, post-write reverification plan, and archive gap list before any SENCO write is allowed.

stage_statuses.title: Full-flow closure readiness before controlled write
stage_statuses.physical_meaning: Before controlled SENCO writes, the run must show one auditable chain from plan, raw open-flow evidence, QC decisions, candidate write package, reverification plan, archive gaps, and formal release domains. This gate is offline and does not touch COM ports or routes.

stage_statuses.title: Formal run status rollup
stage_statuses.reason: formal run status JSON, markdown, gate table, and gap table are indexed
stage_statuses.physical_meaning: The top-level run status separates physical-flow continuation from formal archive, database import, and release readiness without touching analyzer state.

stage_statuses.title: Controlled coefficient write events
stage_statuses.physical_meaning: Any SENCO write starts a new coefficient epoch and must have command, readback, approval, and rollback evidence.

stage_statuses.title: Post-write reverification
stage_statuses.physical_meaning: After any coefficient write, independent open-flow verification points must prove the updated measurement model.

stage_statuses.title: Formal evidence bundle
stage_statuses.physical_meaning: The evidence bundle freezes raw artifacts, QC, traceability, coefficient events, hashes, and report inputs for reconstruction.

stage_statuses.title: Evidence database import
stage_statuses.physical_meaning: PostgreSQL indexes traceability and audit state; raw evidence remains in hashed evidence packages.

stage_statuses.title: Run, technical, and formal calibration reports
stage_statuses.reason: one or more formal report artifacts missing
stage_statuses.physical_meaning: Reports are the reviewer-facing summary of method, QC, traceability, uncertainty, coefficient write status, and limitations.

stage_statuses.title: Per-device calibration and verification certificate package
stage_statuses.physical_meaning: Per-device certificates bind the final device identity, QC result, coefficient state, traceability, hashes, and report-release boundary.
